title: A message about other guests
hook: Two stated cases: explore the reference group used for a descriptive rate contrast.

knows: Reading the stated arithmetic assumptions and a small numerical chart
doesNotKnow: How the reference group used for a descriptive rate contrast affects the stated comparison

misconception: The headline alone determines Gap, regardless of the stated inputs.
objective: Compare the reference group used for a descriptive rate contrast in two explicit finite cases; separate model arithmetic from an empirical population claim.
